title: Video Declutter selector config
description: Data-only description of page parts to hide. Validated at runtime by extension/lib/config.js (validateConfig), which is the source of truth; test/config.test.js keeps both in sync. Selectors must not contain braces, '<', '@', ';', backslash or newlines, 'url(' or '/*'.

version.description: A downloaded config is used only if its version is greater than the bundled one. Bump it on every change.

inactive.description: Containers of pages YouTube keeps in the DOM but hides; probes and counters ignore elements inside them.

homeMessage.description: Element that shows the calm 'recommendations are hidden' text (as ::before) when the home feed is hidden.

click.description: Element clicked once per video (autoplay toggle while it is on).

selector.description: Should match on this page type while the markup is unchanged.

when.description: The check counts only if this matches (e.g. the sidebar is rendered).
